name: Outbound Scout
tagline: Builds a prospecting pipeline from your product link: buyer profile first, then companies.
description: Hand it your product's URL or a two-line blurb and it first pins down who the ideal buyer actually is. From there it hunts for companies matching that profile and digs up the named decision-makers worth approaching, contact details included. It stops at research - no outreach is sent on your behalf.
author: iammutex
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
